column2: As if that could ever happen! Right, Akira-kun?
R-right! All right, I'll help too, Miki!
Waaah!
Hey, get back here!
Then I'm going with Akira-kun!\n\nTwo girls together would be too risky, after all!
So that means I'm with {p}-kun. Nice to have you, {p}-kun!
Y-yeah...
Maybe we'd better switch the teams? If I let you go with a girl this cute... it'd be dangerous!
Hmph! There, teams all set! I'm going with Akira-kun, and {p}'s going with Honey!
Well then, let's go, Akira-kun!
Y-yes, ma'am!
Well then, everyone, see you later!
Now, shall we get going too?
That's odd. I feel like we came down this road a minute ago...
You too?
What on earth is going on...
...Is this the Demons' doing?
It's too early to tell...
Whoa!
Who the hell are you?
No ordinary person can even approach this place. To pass through the Lost Forest and reach the Kuryu Valley...
The Kuryu Valley?
Don't play dumb! You're Sanada's people, aren't you!?
H-hold on a second! You've got it wrong!
Aw, who cares, {p}. I've been tramping through this maze of a forest forever and I'm fed up!
Akira-kun...!
You've got spirit.\n\nI am Miroku Mugen, son of Taigen Mugen, lord of Kuryu Castle!
Taste my sword!
Whoaaa!
Gyaaah!
...You weren't aiming at us?
Your clothes are far too conspicuous. You hardly look like ninja!
Those guys were dressed just like ninja...
Sanada ninja, most likely...
Sanada ninja...? This isn't some samurai drama...
Samurai drama...? What's that? Where did you people come from, anyway?
Actually...
A strange tale... Maybe we'd better consult the great lord. But whether he'll... Hmm...
What's wrong, Miroku-san?
Duh-heh-heh... Miroku, whatcha doin'?
This is Guzumushi the Crybaby of the Kuryu clan! Guzumushi! It seems Sanada ninja have started sneaking in. Warn everyone!
Okaaay... But first, they want you back at the castle... The great lord has... woken up...
My father has? Understood, I'll return to the castle at once. You lot come too.
That Miroku guy's not bad...
It's like we time-slipped back to the end of the Warring States era. Wandering around aimlessly would be more dangerous. Let's go with him.
...Crossed through time... The walls grow lower, little by little...
*Snrk*... *snff*... Welcome, welcome. {p}... *snrk*... Akira Fudo... *snff*... Ryo Asuka! Sit... *snrk*... down.
It's the great lord's order, but I don't trust you yet.
Same goes for us, y'know.
Heh. Let's see what you can do.
And what are we supposed to do?
Whoa!
What's this thread!?
I can't move!
Whoa!
Miroku-san!
Miroku, let me have a go too!\n\nTied up in this creepy thread, like I'm gonna just sit still!
Shut up! Let's go, {p}!
Forgive my rudeness till now.
As long as you get it!
The great lord was right about you after all.\n\nI'll entrust the fate of this journey to you.
...Crossed through time... The walls grow lower, little by little...
What an impressive wall.
Was there ever a building this big in Kanto? Let's find the entrance and go in!
Nothing but sand as far as the eye can see.
Isn't this desert bigger than the building's grounds?
I've got sand even in my ears...
It's like the African savanna in here... But isn't this place way too big?
I really soaked up the great outdoors!
Brrr... I-it's cold!
Brrr... It's so cold!\n\nBut... how come? This ice field seems bigger than the building's grounds...
Shh! I hear something! Like a beast growling... It's getting louder!
Grrrr... Grrrrrr...!
Shouldn't we run?
You finally showed uuup!
Whoa!
It's like you're living in the wild!
By the way, who's Dorano?
...!? You mean a vampire?
When I heard "vampire" I thought Demon, but I guess not. If anything, Kedaman's closer to a Demon, huh?
But he seems totally different from a Demon.
Yeah...
You don't know about the Kanto Hellquake?
...Now there's no doubt that the black moon has the power to link worlds...
When the black moon appeared, Herai Village vanished and became a vacant lot with a warehouse...
Exactly, Mitsurugi-kun.
Yukishiro-san vanished after the black moon appeared, so I don't think that's possible.
Rei Uryu, of the Uryu Conglomerate?
Hmmm...\n\nThe mysterious Rei Uryu is also one of Science City's investors!
Rumor has it Rei Uryu is secretly funding Dr. Kuruma as well.
The two have one thing in common: neither accepts the world as it is.
Dr. Kuruma doesn't recognize the strength of humankind. He fuses different creatures together and calls it evolution!
Exactly right!\n\nEvery friend you've met so far comes from a different world! Even if each of you has a different goal, you're wonderful friends! The world should be changed by all of us together!
Jiro-kun?
It seems you've made up your mind, Jiro-kun.\n\nNow then, Mitsurugi-kun! Any idea where Rei Uryu might be?
The truth is, Science City has an off-limits area, a residential district for investors.
It wouldn't be strange if he were hiding there with Dr. Kuruma.
That's the spirit, everyone!!
